summary: Ordering value of the delivery step; must be >= the pickup's sequence_order.
businessRules: sequence_order defines: Use this parameter to prioritize completing the shipment delivery relative to certain other tasks. A task configured with a sequence_order of 2 will be done after the task with sequence_order of 1,…
Must stay consistent with: shipments.pickup.sequence_order. Changes here may require validation of those fields.
Rule: Capacity dimensions must match across jobs, shipments, and vehicles.
Numeric field; verify sign (positive/negative) and unit from spec.
Optional field. Omitting uses solver's default behavior (no penalty).
testingGuidance: Negative: delivery order less than pickup order -> 400.
Interaction: Infeasible: delivery time window earlier than the pickup window -> precedence infeasible -> both unassigned.
Interaction: Infeasible: two amount [3] shipments onboard together on capacity [5] -> one deferred by capacity.
Interaction: Precedence: pickup [10:00,11:00], delivery [09:00,09:30] (delivery before pickup) -> both unassigned.
